en: Reverse side of a vintage postcard with handwritten German text. Across the top is printed 'POSTKAART – CARTE POSTALE'. On the right is the address field written in German script, and in the upper‑right corner there is an orange postage stamp cancelled with a circular postmark reading 'TARTU' and 'ESTI' (Estonia). The left side contains a longer handwritten message dated 4 October 1930.
